tidbit: Did you know… about 8,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
ForgeCode claims it beats Claude Code and Codex, but reported by Startup Fortune: the fine print shows a 25% score boost via orchestration, not model intelligence.
Claude traced NIST elliptic-curve seeds to Unix timestamps in under 30 minutes, reported by NewsCord: researchers found no backdoors across 12 outlets compared.
DeepSeek releases an model update and opens search API to all users, reported by KLSE Screener.
Reported by 极客公园: DeepSeek launches a new model with lower price and stronger capability, plus rumors of Huawei launching a new brand called Starlight focused on cost-effectiveness.
Confirmed by BBC: UK students use artificial intelligence to apply for jobs, sparking concerns over fairness and authenticity.
Free every hour.
